subject: Re: Hosted API per-1M token rates & supported models
messages:
From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@medlytics.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing request — per-1M token IO split + model list

Hi Tessa,

Quick intro — I lead platform at MedLytics. We're evaluating Redwood for our hosted inference layer for a new feature (summarization + longform generation). Before we schedule a call, can you send your standard per-1M token pricing split by input/output and a list of supported models (including quantized/low-cost variants)?

A few notes on our side:
- Expect ~15M output tokens / month and ~3M input tokens initially (heavy output).
- We'll likely start with the Llama-family and try an open LLM variant for baseline, but may need an instruction-tuned model for production.
- Interested in any programmatic discounts for volume or commit-based pricing.

I've attached a short workbook with our estimated token mix. Can you also confirm whether the hosted API supports streaming + tool-calling for these models?

Thanks —
Ethan
Ethan Shaw
VP, Platform & ML
MedLytics
Attachments: MedLytics_RateRequest.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@medlytics.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing request — per-1M token IO split + model list

Hi Ethan — thanks for the context and the workbook, that helps. High level answers below; attaching our standard ratecard for Q1 2028 with model tiers.

Short answers:
- Standard hosted IO split (list price, per 1M tokens):
  • Input (prompt) tokens: $0.60 per 1M
  • Output (generated) tokens: $1.20 per 1M
- Model families currently available on Hosted API (examples):
  • Redwood-Base (small/quantized low-cost variants) — good for high-throughput prediction.
  • LlamaX-Instruction (moderate cost) — instruction-tuned, recommended for completion/assistant flows.
  • OpenFlare-2 (large) — higher quality for longform generative tasks.
  • Specialized rerank/embedding endpoints (separate billing).
- Streaming and tool-calling are supported for all hosted model variants listed above.

Discounts and commits: we offer 10% off list for 6-month committed spend > $25k/mo, and stepped discounts beyond that. I can loop Ben (cc'd) for a more formal tiered proposal if you can share a 3–6 month usage forecast.

See attached: redwood_ratecard_q1_2028.pdf. Let me know if you want a one-page comparison for the models you flagged. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call next week to go over commit economics.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_ratecard_q1_2028.pdf (application/pdf)

Cc: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@medlytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jan 2028 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing request — per-1M token IO split + model list

Thanks Tessa — that layout is helpful. A couple follow-ups after reviewing the card: 

1) The IO split in our workbook assumes 85% output / 15% input (token counts I shared). If we delivered mostly output-heavy workloads, would Redwood offer a configuration or rate that favors cheaper output pricing (e.g., bundled output blocks) or is the per-token split fixed?

2) We're exploring a pilot commit to validate latency/cost; curious if there's a pilot discount (one-off) or a pilot commitment path before a 6-month commit.

3) Do you have any guidance on model recommendations for summarization + longform that balances latency and cost (we want something better than base but not as expensive as OpenFlare-2 for steady-state)? Any quantized instruction variants that preserve quality?

If you need more concrete numbers I can update the sheet, but wanted to surface these questions first.

—Ethan

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@medlytics.ai>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing request — per-1M token IO split + model list

Hi Ethan — Ben here on renewals/discounting. Short answers:

1) Per-token split is our default billing model, but for output-heavy workloads we can discuss blended output bundles (e.g., buy N output token-blocks at a reduced rate) for pilots. Those are treated as prepaid credits and can be structured to apply only to output tokens.

2) Pilot options: We typically offer a one-month pilot at 20% off list (applies to total spend capped at $10k) or a 3-month pilot at 10% off with a modest commit (~$15k/mo). For enterprise pilots we can craft a custom path.

3) Model guidance: based on your use case I'd recommend starting with LlamaX-Instruction-XL quantized variant — best tradeoff for good longform quality with ~25-35% cost savings vs unquantized OpenFlare-2. We can provision a perf profile so you can A/B test.

I've attached a simple proposal template with the two pilot options and preliminary pricing tiers (see redwood_ratecard_q1_2028.pdf). If you'd like an exception to grant a deeper pilot discount, I'll need LA approval — looping Laura to confirm authority for any bespoke concession.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_ratecard_q1_2028.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@medlytics.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing request — per-1M token IO split + model list

Ben / Tessa — approved for a one-month pilot at 25% off list (exception) capped at $12k total spend. Conditions:
- Pilot discount applies to total invoice for the pilot month only.
- Pilot must start within 30 days of sign-off and MedLytics must provide a brief feedback summary within 45 days.
- If MedLytics converts to a committed plan within 60 days, we'll apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the pilot discount toward the first committed invoice.

Ethan — happy to extend this to help you validate latency/cost. Ben or Tessa will send an updated proposal with the pilot terms and a link to a DocuSign for the pilot addendum.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
